title: AFDBench: A Reasoning-First AI Scientist for NationalWeather Service Forecast Discussions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hallucinate numerical values when generating high-stakes meteorological text, posing risks for weather communication. We present AFDBench, an AI meteorologist that generates professional Area Forecast Discussions (AFDs) by reasoning through structured AI weather forecast data from Google's WeatherNext 2. We introduce AFDBench, the first benchmark for evaluating generative meteorological reasoning, comprising 7,732 expert written discussions from 13 National Weather Service (NWS) offices paired with real AI weather forecast inputs, and three complementary metrics: Met-Align (numerical accuracy), Style-Align (professional dialect adherence), and Input-Grounding (fidelity to source weather data). Zero-shot evaluations reveal that open-source LLMs achieve low Style-Align (~0.33) and moderate Input-Grounding (~0.88), failing to write in the professional NWS register or faithfully use their input data. We apply Gro

translated_title: AFDBench：面向国家气象服务预报讨论的推理优先AI科学家
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成高风险气象文本时会幻觉化数值，这对天气传播构成风险。我们提出AFDBench，一种AI气象学家，通过推理Google WeatherNext 2的结构化AI天气预报数据来生成专业的区域预报讨论（AFDs）。我们引入AFDBench，这是首个评估生成性气象推理的基准，包含来自13个国家气象服务（NWS）办公室的7,732篇专家撰写的讨论，并与真实的AI天气预报输入配对，以及三个互补指标：Met-Align（数值准确性）、Style-Align（专业术语遵循度）和Input-Grounding（对源天气数据的忠实度）。零样本评估显示，开源LLMs在Style-Align上得分较低（约0.33），在Input-Grounding上得分中等（约0.88），未能以专业NWS语域写作或忠实使用其输入数据。我们应用Gro...
tldr: 提出了AFDBench，首个用于评估生成性气象推理的基准，并引入了三个互补指标来检测LLM在气象文本生成中的数值幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: AFDBench is the first benchmark for evaluating generative meteorological reasoning, introducing three complementary metrics to detect numerical hallucination in LLM-generated weather text.
